spec.description: Every product the exchange lists, trading or not. The response is a bare array, not an object wrapping one, so there is nothing to unwrap and no envelope to declare.

response.title: Products
response.description: Every listed product, in no documented order.

notes: No `pagination` block: the endpoint takes no cursor and no limit, and answers with the whole list in one response. Around 800 products and a third of a megabyte, which is worth knowing before calling it in a loop.
